rm_source.description: Reference document/source used for the field definitions

otac0_offset.description: Byte offset of OTAC0 in NVR, default 0x100

otac_high0_offset.description: Byte offset of OTAC_HIGH0 in NVR, default 0x108

bank0_base.description: F4MDD PFlash Bank0 base address, default 0x01000000

bank1_base.description: F4MDD PFlash Bank1 base address, default 0x01200000

bank_size.description: F4MDD OTA bank size, fixed at 0x00200000 for this demo

enable_code.description: OTA enable code; enabled OTA requires 0b01010 / 0x0A

low_start.description: Lower 1MB OTA range start, absolute PFlash address or 1MB-relative offset

low_end.description: Lower 1MB OTA range inclusive end, absolute PFlash address or 1MB-relative offset

high_start.description: Upper 1MB OTA range start, absolute PFlash address or 1MB-relative offset

high_end.description: Upper 1MB OTA range inclusive end, absolute PFlash address or 1MB-relative offset

version_offset.description: OTAC0[51:32], PFlash logical offset inside the selected 1MB half

enabled.description: Generate optional PFlash OTA content/indicator records from RM Table 55

layout.description: Byte layout of the 16-byte OTA content at version_offset. Default puts the lower 64-bit version pair first.

low_version.description: 32-bit software version written to the Low OTA indicator

high_version.description: 32-bit software version written to the High OTA indicator

valid_code_f4mdd.description: RM Table 55 valid code for F4MDDxxxT1C

valid_code_f4mds.description: RM Table 55 valid code for F4MDSxxxT1C
